thread:
maria: quick heads up — compliance pinged me asking for an export that shows *who changed routing/quotas/policies*, with before/after diffs and the auth method used (ui/api/service-account). they want CSV/NDJSON and a small inline viewer in Console :warning:

alex: we already emit events but they’re inconsistent. some changes are recorded as whole-object snapshots, others as high-level 'policy replaced' records. downstream tooling expects diffs instead of blobs.

devon: proposal: emit atomic change events for config mutations. fields: resource_type, resource_id, field_path (jq-like), old_value, new_value, actor, actor_type, auth_method, request_id, ip, region, rollout_id?, timestamp. keep event_id immutable.

priya: from Console UX: show a 3-line inline diff summary in the audit panel (changed: quota.max_tokens 2000 -> 5000), with a link "view full diff" that opens a modal showing the NDJSON record and a rendered diff. also allow filters: actor, resource, field_path, time range.

kevin: two compliance constraints: (1) must be able to redact PII in payloads on export (configurable redaction rules, per-customer), (2) exports must include provenance to prove chain-of-custody (signed manifest or export hash).

alex: agree. implementation questions: do we alter existing audit schema or append a parallel `change_events` stream? For backwards compat I'd prefer additive: keep current snapshot events and add normalized change events for routing/quota/policy subsystems.

devon: +1 additive. For historical reconstructability we should also keep a mapping event: when a policy ref changes, emit a set of field-level deltas for the derived effective config so auditors can see "what actually changed" rather than just ref id swap.

maria: is there a concern around volume? lots of small deltas could blow up token storage.

devon: yes. mitigation ideas: (a) sampling for high-frequency internal changes (config churn), (b) compress diffs into a single bundle for batched deploys with a rollout_id, (c) TTL/rollup for older than X days but keep exports immutable.

priya: Console UX: when we show inline diffs we should surface rollout_id and a small 'rollback' link for owners only (not to actually rollback from audit view, but deep-link to the rollout page). RBAC applies.

kevin: export API shape suggestion: GET /api/v1/audit/exports?from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-15&format=ndjson&include_change_events=true&redact=pii&owner_id=org-123

alex: sample NDJSON line for a change event (one-per-line):
```
{"event_id":"evt_01F...","ts":"2026-03-15T12:01:17Z","resource_type":"routing_policy","resource_id":"rp-42","field_path":"rules[3].priority","old_value":3,"new_value":1,"actor":"svc-deploy-bot","actor_type":"service","auth_method":"jwt", "request_id":"req_abc123","rollout_id":"ro_999","region":"us-west-2"}
```

kevin: we should also include a metadata header file for each export: export_manifest.json with sha256sum, schema_version, retention_policy, redaction_applied=true/false. auditors expect that.

audit-bot: export job queued by maria at 2026-03-15T12:02:01Z. estimated size: 4.2MB (change_events only). ETA 21s.

audit-bot: export ready: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/1768000001-20260315-change-events.ndjson.gz (sha256: e3b0c442...), manifest: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/1768000001-20260315-manifest.json

maria: perfect, thanks — can we action a spike to add change_events and the Console inline diff? devon/alex, can you take the spike and list out the schema + retention/rollup options by EOD? :thumbsup:

alex: on it.

devon: will sketch schema + perf notes and post a short doc in #eng-platform later today.

priya: will mock the inline diff and filters and add to the Console backlog.

kevin: I'll draft redaction policy and manifest spec for legal.

maria: awesome — closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
